body.note: A slice shape gives the number of chips along each dimension of the interconnect. A 2D shape is written AxB and a 3D shape AxBxC. Multiply the dimensions to get the number of chips in the slice.
The Cloud TPU API is no longer under active development and is not supported on and later. Create capacity with Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) or Compute Engine.
JAX and PyTorch are supported on . TensorFlow is not.
To create a TPU VM without an external IP address, add the --internal-ips flag. The VM can then reach Google APIs and services only through Private Google Access.
